text:
Sofia Patel: Quick ask — can we do a lightweight RICE snapshot to compare a Dedicated-first push vs a Private-first push for Q3 investment planning? Trying to get a tiebreaker for the roadmap review tomorrow.

Anna Chen: +1. Short and pragmatic please. We only need rough numbers to argue tradeoffs to GTM.

Mike Alvarez: Happy to. My gut: Dedicated = faster revenue ramp (SMB + midmarket), Private = higher AR but slower sales cycle. Will sketch R/I/C/E in a minute.

Tom Nguyen: FYI ops constraints: Dedicated autoscale & burst changes are mostly infra work we can reuse. Private needs VPC onboarding, KMS handshake, and on‑prem packaging — bigger integration cost.

Sofia Patel: Exactly the sort of context. If someone can throw a 10‑minute matrix that calls out launch criteria + known blockers that'd be perfect.

Mike Alvarez: Ok quick draft (very rough):
```
Initiative: Dedicated GPU pools (reserved capacity)
Reach: 8 (broad self-serve + existing pilot customers)
Impact: 7 (low latency wins PLG motion)
Confidence: 6 (we have infra patterns but need new billing hooks)
Effort: 5 (3 months engineering + infra + docs)
RICE score ≈ (8*7*6)/5 = 67.2

Initiative: Private (VPC/on-prem)
Reach: 3 (enterprise, slower uptake)
Impact: 9 (higher revenue per customer + deals)
Confidence: 5 (security/compliance unknowns for some industries)
Effort: 9 (6+ months, legal & packaging, on-prem validation)
RICE score ≈ (3*9*5)/9 = 15
```

Anna Chen: Nice. Also add non-RICE considerations: strategic sales plays, competitive risk, deployability in EMEA/APAC, and compliance gating for some customers. Those can change weightings.

Tom Nguyen: One more op note: Dedicated provides an easier fall-back path (we can route to hosted variants during upgrades), whereas Private needs more robust upgrade/shim strategies. That adds hidden effort/cost.

Sofia Patel: From the product lens: launch criteria for Dedicated would be: latency SLOs met on reserved pools, simple quota & billing, ok console UX for capacity reservation, and a small beta with 2 pilot customers. For Private: must have VPC control plane, KMS integration, and an enterprise install checklist — which pushes timeline.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: infra/billing hook spike branch merged to staging at 2023-11-01T15:00Z :white_check_mark:

Mike Alvarez: Given the quick RICE numbers + ops notes, I recommend a Dedicated-first path with parallel investment in Private discovery & compliance work. That lets us capture low-friction revenue while derisking Private.

Anna Chen: +1. For roadmap language: "Primary Q3 investment: Dedicated reserved capacity (launch beta). Secondary: Private — compliance & packaging workstream with milestones for legal/KMS and an enterprise pilot in H2."

Sofia Patel: Good — I'll fold this into the roadmap deck and surface the RICE snapshot + launch criteria. Thanks all. If anyone has an enterprise customer that insists on Private as gating for deal, DM me and we'll escalate. :handshake:
